setIsSpinning(false); } }, 100); // tốc độ quay } catch (error: any) { message.error(error?.response?.data?.message || "Something went wrong"); setIsSpinning(false); } }; const rewardItems = [ { id: 1, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.1", reward: "0.1" }, { id: 2, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.5", reward: "0.5" }, { id: 3, img: rw1, reward: "Duck_Sticker" }, { id: 4, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.1", reward: "0.1" }, { id: 5, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$0.2", reward: "0.2" }, { id: 6, img: rw3, reward: "Robot_Part" }, { id: 7, img: "https://demo5.speedcode.online/public/coin (2).png", label: "$5", reward: "5" }, { id: 8, img: rw2, reward: "Lucky_Clover" }, ];
